test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c3e2097d6856e6af9806c30ee9b54ce4951760190825e9697e44d0f241058a9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series → The element shift anticlockwise and is rotated 135º clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25de8fda752261c31d2f7e3c78fea8292d93e9111749912739a55876d7743e2e.png] 

2) Second box series → The element is rotated 135º clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/836c91d719dd863ceb670480005631b8aad49590fb23bd72ec5a4047eeca51b4.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1c650d80a7a3b4c2977cfffff95c3093e50fe29d782a6a7cd58ef8a3cb6d665.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
